content.title: City of Arvada Grants Portal
content.summary: The City of Arvada has launched a new online platform for submitting applications for Human Services and Community Development Block grants. This portal is designed to streamline the grant application process for users.
content.body: The City of Arvada has a new online grant application platform for the Human Services and Community Development Block grant applications. [Utilize this platform for all of your grant application needs.](https://www.grantinterface.com/Home/Logon?urlkey=arvada)
